Definition: probably another form of G971; to squeeze, i.e. seize (gently by the hand (press), or officially (arrest), or in hunting (capture)):--apprehend, catch, lay hand on, take. Compare G4085.
BiblicalUsage: Piazo means to seize, to lay hold of a person — gently by the hand, or officially, by arrest. The officers sought to take Jesus in John 7:30, but no man laid hands on Him, because His hour had not yet come. Herod did apprehend Peter and put him in prison in Acts 12:4, and the disciples caught nothing all night in John 21:3.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe no hand can seize what God's hour has not yet given, and no prison can hold what He means to free.
